what_happened.line: Members leaned toward renewing the DeWolfe music subscription while looking for another vendor, with no vote taken.
The committee reached consensus, without a formal vote, to buy a hybrid-meeting camera and microphone unit.
The manager is to bring a draft request for proposals for a freestanding studio lighting system to the next meeting.
The chair will invite the town manager to the next meeting to discuss future studio space, placed third on the agenda.
The November minutes were approved as amended by roll call; bylaw changes on vacancies and student membership were tabled pending information from the select board.

why_it_matters: The committee oversees the town's public-access studio and its meeting broadcasts, so equipment and licence choices set what residents can watch remotely.
Spending on the camera, lighting and music licence is settled by consensus rather than recorded votes, and a draft budget is due on an agenda ahead of a spring finance committee meeting.
